files_needing_same_fix_outside_contract.detail: Calls runner.run_source('collector-tw-taifex-vix', run_id='vix1') and runner2.run_source('collector-tw-taifex-vix', run_id='vix2') without started_at/finished_at, so TaifexVixSpider.collect() computes current_month from the wall clock in Asia/Taipei (UTC+8) and marks daily:202611 finished in state/taifex_vix_ledger.json once month < current_month ('202611' < '202612'), causing the second run to emit 0 items and fail assert len(ids2) == 1.
